sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (multiple SI slabs referenced but ranges not listed)

room_rent.display: Varies by plan: 1% SI/day (Support), Single Private Room (Secure), No cap (Support Plus, Shield, Premium)
room_rent.note: Support plan: 1% of SI/day with proportionate deduction. Secure plan: Single Private Room with proportionate deduction. Support Plus, Shield, Premium plans: no room rent cap. Optional Cover 38 (Room Rent Modifier) can upgrade Secure plan to any room or twin sharing.

icu.display: 2% of SI/day (Support); Actuals (Secure, Support Plus, Shield, Premium)
icu.note: Support plan: ICU capped at 2% of SI per day. Secure plan and above: ICU at actuals.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay on admissible claim amount for insured persons aged 61 or more at Policy Inception Date. Additionally, zone-based co-pay applies (25-35%) if treatment taken in higher zone. Voluntary co-pay also available as optional cover. Mandatory co-pay can be waived via Optional Cover 17.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped (₹25k–₹1L/eye by plan); psychiatric disorders ₹50k sub-limit; OPD dental/spectacles 30% of OPD limit
sub_limits.note: Cataract: Support ₹25,000/eye, Secure & Support Plus ₹35,000/eye, Shield ₹50,000/eye, Premium ₹1,00,000/eye. Specified psychiatric conditions (severe depression, schizophrenia, bipolar, PTSD, OCD, panic, personality disorders): ₹50,000 cumulative sub-limit after 36-month wait. IVF, Bariatric, Lasik, Psychiatric treatment each have plan-level sub-limits per Product Benefits Table. OPD dental/spectacles/hearing aids: 30% of OPD annual limit.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Aggregate Deductible (Optional Cover 3) and Per Claim Deductible (Optional Cover 27) available as optional covers to convert policy into a top-up.

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses (Excl03). Can be reduced to 7 days via policy schedule option, or waived via Optional Cover 19 (Reduction of First Thirty Days Waiting Period) or Optional Cover 35 (Insta Cover).

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 36 months from first policy inception. Can be reduced via Optional Cover 18 (Reduction of PED Waiting Period) or waived from Day 1 via Optional Cover 35 (Insta Cover for declared/accepted conditions).

specific_disease_waiting.note: 17 listed conditions (cataract, hernia, stones, hysterectomy, osteoarthritis, etc.) have 24-month specific waiting period. Can be reduced via Optional Cover 28 (Reduction of Specific Disease Waiting Period).

maternity.display: Covered inbuilt (48mo wait) for Family Floater; also available as optional cover
maternity.note: Inbuilt maternity benefit (Section 2.28) available for legally married couple on same Family Floater policy with 48-month wait from Policy Inception Date. Covers up to 2 deliveries/terminations. New Born Baby cover and vaccination also included. Optional Cover 7 (Maternity Benefits) available for plans without inbuilt cover. Optional Cover 22 (Enhanced Maternity) and Optional Cover 30 (1-year wait for maternity, 3-year policy only) also available. Limit as per Product Benefits Table.

cumulative_bonus.note: Support plan: 10%/yr up to 50%. Secure plan: 10%/yr up to 50%. Support Plus plan: 10%/yr up to 100%. Shield plan: 20%/yr up to 100%. Premium plan: 33.33%/yr up to 100%. Bonus Booster (Optional Cover 6) upgrades Support/Secure/Support Plus to 20%/yr up to 100%. Bonus Booster Plus (Optional Cover 24) and Infinite Bonus Booster (Optional Cover 25) offer further customisation.

restoration.note: Section 2.21: 100% recharge of SI unlimited times per year from 2nd claim onwards, but NOT for same/related illness by default. Optional Cover 13 (Recharge Benefit for Same Illnesses) extends recharge to same/related illness as well. Recharge SI not counted for cumulative bonus.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation days as per plan specified in Product Benefits Table. Super Saver Pack (Optional Cover 33) provides 60 days. Enhanced Pre & Post Hospitalisation Cover (Optional Cover 9) also available. Exact base days not stated in wording text for each plan.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation days as per plan specified in Product Benefits Table. Super Saver Pack (Optional Cover 33) provides 180 days. Optional Cover 23 (Extensive Post Hospitalisation) provides 180 days if Optional Cover 9 is also opted. Exact base days not stated in wording text for each plan.

day_care.display: All day-care (extensive list in Annexure III)
day_care.note: Day care treatment covered under Section 2.4. Annexure III lists 541+ day care procedures across all specialties.

domiciliary.note: Section 2.7: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if continuous for at least 3 days and patient cannot be moved to hospital or hospital bed unavailable. Pre and post hospitalisation also payable if domiciliary claim admitted.

ayush.note: Section 2.8: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered at recognised AYUSH hospitals (Government, teaching, or registered standalone). Exclusion 3.2.3 (alternative treatment exclusion) does not apply to this benefit. Liability up to Sum Insured.

organ_donor.note: Section 2.6: Inpatient hospitalisation expenses of organ donor covered for insured person's organ transplant surgery. Pre/post hospitalisation, screening and acquisition costs of donor organ excluded.

ambulance.display: As per Product Benefits Table (per hospitalisation)
ambulance.note: Section 2.5: Road ambulance covered up to limit in Product Benefits Table per hospitalisation for emergency. Air ambulance also covered inbuilt (Section 2.32) and as Optional Cover 16, up to limits in Product Benefits Table.

modern_treatments.note: Section 2.14: Robotic surgeries, stereotactic radiosurgeries, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injections), intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, HIFU, green/holmium laser prostate treatment, IONM, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic for bone marrow transplant) all covered up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Optional Cover 12 (Non-payable Expense Cover): covers items listed in Annexure II List I (gloves, consumables, etc.) under inpatient and day care. Not covered in base plan.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt emergency (Premium plan); Optional for others
global_cover.note: Section 2.31: Worldwide Emergency Hospitalisation Cover is inbuilt in Premium plan (up to 50% of SI, max ₹20L, with ₹2L deductible per claim). Available as Optional Cover 10 for other plans (up to 50% SI, max ₹10L, ₹2L deductible). Optional Cover 21 (Global Cover) covers planned treatment abroad up to SI or ₹50L (not available for Support plan). Inbuilt base value used for ranking.

moratorium.note: Section 4.1.12: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no policy or claim can be contested on grounds of non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium payment modes and 15 days for monthly mode. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments during policy period.

free_look.note: Section 4.1.15: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies. Not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Section 4.1.9: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Sleep apnea/snoring; specific genetic/hereditary diseases (Crohn's, Haemophilia, Neurofibromatosis etc.); external congenital anomaly; war/nuclear/chemical; dental (non-accidental); refractive error <7.5D

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness lump sum, Personal Accident, Aggregate/Per Claim Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay, Maternity, OPD Cover, Global Cover, Non-payable Expense, Recharge for same illness, Bonus Booster, Insta Cover (Day-1 PED), Unlimited Care, Surrogacy/Oocyte Donor
